Implementation Plan

Plan for issue #7181 (re-issue of #6766): make the automation-path approval gate default-on

## Planning ref
- The planning context recorded `1fbd7eb42fc9a9b2d0d51f3245b7f003b3ab85bc` on `main`. The checkout I read is `89ea48780080b1d681bc41007c5e1a2a2aeb11c9` on `main`, because `main` moved on. There is no integration-branch metadata, so there is no mismatch.
- The line numbers below are from `89ea487`.

## Reading the clarification answer
- **Q1 → A+B.**
  - **A:** flip the default of `AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED` from `false` to `true` everywhere. An explicit `false` keeps working as the opt-out.
  - **B:** also add the missing regression tests for both stall-recovery paths (managed and standalone):
    - a security finding with no grant is held;
    - a plan whose paths are all granted is approved;
    - a missing plan or missing guard fails closed.

## Automation and wiring (§20.E)
- **Scripts:** no new script. This changes existing code only: two workflows, the poller script, tests and docs.
- **Entry points:** both are existing ones.
  - `.github/workflows/plan.yml`, step "Auto-approve clear plan", runs on `issue_comment` `/answer`.
  - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, step "Process each tracking issue", runs on the `*/5` schedule through `internal-orchestrate-poll.yml`.
- **Supervisor:** none needed.
- **DB work:** none.
- **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`:** no entry, since no new script is added.

Scope-mode: Selective Expansion
Reuse-audit: extends _automation_path_plan_auto_approval_gate
Scope-mode justification: The gate from #6838 already exists. It uses the unchanged classifier and exact-grant parser in `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py` (`--emit-automation-grant` / `--check-automation-paths`), the plan-path extractor kept byte-identical in two places, and the hold-marker reporting. The only gap is that it is off by default. The fix flips three fallbacks and makes the poller read an unset flag as "on". That makes the bug fix part of option A. Option B adds the missing standalone and security-finding regressions and docs. A full implementation costs only a few lines more than flipping defaults alone, and it moves correctness under §6 (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed). No guard logic, marker format, extractor or human `/approved` path changes.

Any other value, including empty or unrecognised, runs it (fail closed). Invert the `case` so the falsy branch is a no-op and `*)` runs the existing gate body unchanged.
